recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: space mirror approved to test lighting the night sky
the internet rebuilt from first principles on a hacker thread
smoke rising over Spanish summer hills
July fog rolling through San Francisco at thirteen degrees
Enya and Fleetwood Mac drifting through a quiet coding week

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Ride a stutter-house pulse through foggy SF blocks — tap on beat fractures to keep a glowing orb synced as the groove subdivides into tighter micro-rhythms.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: rhythm tap on shifting beat grid
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one 30-second loop equals a full track cycle; nail the final stutter burst for a satisfying drop-out.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, beat slices multiply, late taps leave trailing ghost notes that clutter the lane.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe streets dissolving into fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Steer an orbital mirror to catch dawn light and paint it across dark rooftops before the city wakes — too much glare scorches, too little leaves blocks cold.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: aim and sweep reflected light beams
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: illuminate five rooftops in 45 seconds; each successful beam leaves a lingering warm glow.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: cloud bands sweep across the sky, rooftops shrink, acceptable angle windows tighten.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: minimalist celestial blueprint on deep indigo

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw single-stroke packet routes between drifting dream-pop nodes — connections fade like reverb tails unless you retrace them before packets arrive.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: deliver eight packets across one screen before the ambient wave washes routes away.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: nodes spawn faster, paths decay quicker, interference ripples force detours.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor pastel nodes on soft grain paper

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe embers and ash into cool-blue and hot-orange bins as wind shifts — mis-sorted sparks feed a creeping smoke wall at the screen edge.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe left/right to shift sorting lanes
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: survive one full wind gust cycle (~40 sec) with the smoke wall still at bay.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind speed doubles, ember types multiply, bin capacity shrinks mid-round.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout silhouettes against ochre smoke gradients
